name: Antigravity

form_factor.comment: Google Antigravity IDE, standalone agy CLI, IDE extensions, Python SDK, and Remote Control in a browser. Remote Control connects back to the user's running desktop agent. Per-form-factor links: CLI: https://www.antigravity.google/docs/cli/overview/; IDE: https://antigravity.google/download; Extension: https://www.antigravity.google/docs/ide/extensions/; SDK: https://www.antigravity.google/docs/sdk/overview/; Web: https://www.antigravity.google/docs/remote-control/.

released_in.comment: IDE public release in 2025; standalone agy CLI documented May 2026.

latest_major_update.comment: Antigravity 2.18.1 shipped September 28, 2026 with an in-product plugin marketplace and Customizations tab, archived-conversation filtering, safer permission prompts for hidden workspace files, and fixes for subagent worktree classification, prompt editing, focus, and conversation reliability.

rules.comment: Full plugin rules on CLI; IDE has persistent agent context with overlapping rules support. Location: Antigravity plugin rules live in plugin folders; workspace/global IDE rule storage is managed by Antigravity.

skills.comment: Plugin skills on CLI; IDE local data includes skills with less public doc detail. Location: plugin skill folders containing `SKILL.md`.

mcp_servers.comment: CLI plugin mcp_config.json; IDE also ships MCP configuration. Location: plugin `mcp_config.json` files and IDE/CLI MCP configuration.

custom_commands.comment: CLI via plugin capabilities; IDE via global workflows rather than classic slash-command folders. Location: command-like behavior is via plugins/workflows rather than a documented standalone command folder.

goal_command.comment: Antigravity CLI docs cover plugins, sandbox, and slash commands but do not document a Codex-style `/goal` primitive.

subagents.comment: The SDK supports dynamic self-cloning subagents and static custom subagents with isolated context windows, toolsets, permissions, and system instructions.

monitor.comment: Public Antigravity CLI/plugin docs reviewed here do not establish whether an agent-side background monitor/watch primitive exists.

model_selection.comment: IDE model UI exists; agy --help does not expose a model flag as of this dataset.

approval_mode.comment: CLI supports --dangerously-skip-permissions; IDE approval behavior not fully documented.

continue.comment: CLI --continue for latest conversation; IDE continues from existing history.

output_format.comment: The Antigravity SDK supports real-time token and reasoning streams plus Pydantic-validated structured JSON output.

statusline.comment: The CLI can pipe detailed live agent state as JSON to a user script and render its ANSI output in a custom TUI status line.

custom_model_provider.comment: The SDK runs local LiteRT checkpoints or connects to arbitrary local OpenAI-compatible servers with configurable model and base URL, including Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM.

notes: Google Antigravity spans an agentic IDE, IDE extensions, the agy CLI, Remote Control, and a Python agent SDK with a related managed REST/gRPC API. It is distinct from deprecated Gemini CLI.

pricing.value: Free $0/month; Google AI Pro/Ultra credits for overage; Organization via Google Cloud consumption
pricing.comment: Google Antigravity pricing lists a $0 individual plan, Google AI Pro/Ultra paths, and an Organization plan through Google Cloud consumption.

some_free_usage.comment: Google announced Antigravity public preview availability at no charge with rate limits.

hosted_agent.comment: Google documents a managed cloud REST/gRPC Antigravity Agent API alongside the local Python SDK runtime.

transcripts.comment: The CLI exposes the absolute active JSONL transcript path to status-line scripts. Conversation artifacts and summaries also live under the Antigravity brain directory.

transcript_location.comment: Official status-line documentation shows the active conversation transcript as JSONL under the conversation's Antigravity brain directory.

keyboard_shortcuts.comment: Official CLI settings documentation includes customizable keybindings, and the IDE exposes keyboard-shortcut settings.

theme_customization.comment: Antigravity 2.17.0 added a command-palette action that toggles directly between light and dark themes.
